title: Testing The VIRAL Nose Strips
description:
#shorts #gadgets #products 

All of my finds are linked in my bio and in the video for you!


Honest Review: Although I didn’t expect these to actually work it honestly turned out better than I expected. The only problem with this is, if you sweat a lot the stickers that hold the magnets might fall off. But other than that, I actually felt like I could breathe a lot more air through my nose. So that’s why I gave this product an 8.5!
